bead.title: Implement sticky utilization-aware local routing
bead.description: Coordinate the spec and implementation work for sticky utilization-aware routing across local OpenAI-compatible providers. The target behavior is: provider type drives observability; vLLM and llama-server expose normalized endpoint utilization; new long-running worker sequences choose the least-loaded equivalent local endpoint; requests in the same sequence stay pinned to that endpoint; route-status/session evidence expose sticky and utilization facts; multi-machine correctness is tracked separately through shared lease design. This epic owns decomposition only; child beads carry implementation scope and acceptance.
bead.acceptance: 1. All child beads are closed with evidence. 2. docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-003-providers.md and FEAT-004-model-routing.md include acceptance criteria for provider-owned vLLM/llama-server utilization, go-vcr real-server cassettes, sticky same-key routing, and different-key load distribution. 3. go test ./... passes after implementation beads land.
